blurb: Guests visit a family-run estate winery located on a former peach orchard in Summerland, BC. The winery produces small-batch wines from grapes grown on site, benefiting from the unique terroir of volcanic soils, hot summer days, and lake breezes. Visitors can enjoy wine tastings in a cozy log tasting room and explore the vineyard and cellar.
